Anatomi atlası V28

İskelet, kas, deri, dolaşım, solunum, görme, sindirim ve boşaltım sabit olarak birlikte gösteriliyor. Bu bölümde animasyon çalışmaz. İç yapılar için deri ve kaslar saydamdır. Bu görünümde külot gizlenir. Kılcallar ayrı büyütülmüş şemada incelenir.

Termal kamera görünümü

Soğuk renkler → sıcak renkler · Temsili ölçek, °C değildir

Termal kamera görünümü taklididir; ölçülmüş sıcaklık veya °C değeri içermez. Renkler örnek bedensel duyumları anlatır; gerçek vücut sıcaklığına ya da tanıya çevrilemez. Tepkiler kişiye ve duruma göre değişir. Harita araştırmanın sayısal verilerinin kopyası değildir.

İdrar yolu: böbrek → böbrek havuzu → üreter → mesane → üretra. Burada boşaltımın idrar sistemi gösterilir; renkler yapıları ayırmak içindir.

30 saniyelik hızlandırılmış öğretim animasyonu. Besin hareketi sağdaki büyütülmüş şemada gösterilir; gerçek sindirim saatler sürer. Sarı: emilebilen besin · kahverengi: lifli artık · mavi: su.

Besin yolu: ağız → yutak → yemek borusu → mide → ince bağırsak → kalın bağırsak → rektum → anüs. Bu atlasın ileum, çekum ve rektum için ayrı modelleri yoktur. Renkler yapıları ayırmak içindir.
GÖZ → GÖRME YOLLARI → BEYİN

Göz ve beyin atlas modelleridir. Işınlar ve sinyal yolları şematiktir.
● Oksijence zengin kan
● Oksijence fakir kan
● Kılcal ağ: büyütülmüş inceleme

Organlar ve büyük damarlar: Z-Anatomy tabanlı atlas. Kılcal ağ ve akış: ayrı büyütülmüş şema. Hareketli noktalar şematik akış işaretleridir. Animasyonlar öğretim amaçlıdır; tıbbi simülasyon değildir. Mavi, kanın gerçek rengi değildir.

Bir yapıya tıklayarak adını görün.

Örnek ritim: 72 atım/dk · 12 soluk/dk

Nefes alıyor
2 sn nefes al · 3 sn nefes ver
Bilimsel kaynaklar ve model lisansı

Nummenmaa ve ark. — Öznel bedensel duyum haritaları (ısı ölçümü değildir) · NIMH — Depresyon

NIH/NIDDK — İdrar yolları ve işleyişi · Böbreklerin çalışması

NIH/NEI — Göz nasıl çalışır?
Anatomy of the visual pathways — literatür

Kaynakları okumak, uygulamanın bu kurumlarca onaylandığı anlamına gelmez.

WHO — kalp ve damar sağlığı
NIH/NHLBI — nefes alma ve gaz alışverişi
OpenStax — damar yapısı, arteriyol ve kılcal ağ

Soluk alma: diyafram kasılır ve aşağı iner, göğüs boşluğu genişler. Sakin soluk verme: kaslar gevşer, akciğerler elastik geri dönüşle küçülür. Buradaki 2+3 saniyelik döngü bir öğretim örneğidir.

Atardamar kalpten uzaklaştırır; toplardamar kalbe getirir. Akciğer atardamarında oksijence fakir, akciğer toplardamarında oksijence zengin kan taşınır. Kılcallarda madde alışverişi olur.

Anatria3D — anatomical mesh assets
==================================

The 3D meshes and anatomical nomenclature in this directory are NOT covered by
the Anatria3D application licence. They come from open anatomical datasets and
keep the terms their authors set.

**There are two atlases here, from two unrelated sources, under two different
licences.** See the LICENSE file alongside this one for which files are which.
The short version: `*_male.glb` and `manifest.json` are CC BY-SA 4.0;
`*_female.glb` and `manifest_female.json` are CC BY 4.0.


THE MALE ATLAS — CC BY-SA 4.0
=============================

Attribution chain
-----------------

1. BodyParts3D
   The Database Center for Life Science (DBCLS), Japan
   Licensed under Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 2.1 Japan
   https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.1/jp/

2. Z-Anatomy — the libre 3D atlas of anatomy
   Derived from BodyParts3D.
   Licensed under Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International
   https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/
   https://www.z-anatomy.com/

3. Anatria3D adaptations
   The .glb files here are adaptations of the Z-Anatomy meshes, produced by a
   headless Blender export (tools/asset-pipeline/): conversion from .blend to
   glTF binary, Blender modifiers baked into the exported geometry, lossy Draco
   compression (position quantisation 14 bits, normal 10), materials dropped in
   favour of shading applied by the viewer, and the addition of stable organ
   identifiers. The anatomical hierarchy in manifest.json is derived from
   Z-Anatomy's own collection nesting. No polygon reduction is applied beyond
   what Draco quantisation implies.

   Anatomical labels are taken from Z-Anatomy's TA2.csv (Terminologia
   Anatomica 2). That file is shipped unmodified, and it is not a clean copy of
   the standard: an audit of every label found 61 terms misspelled, truncated,
   or naming a structure other than the English beside them — `Truncus
   coeiiacus` for *coeliacus*, `Venae pudendales extemae` for *externae*,
   `Arteria pancreaticoduodenalis` for the *inferior* one, and fifty rows that
   had taken the French spelling from the neighbouring column. All are
   corrected as the file is read, never in the file itself, so the vendored
   standard stays byte-identical to upstream and the corrections stay
   reviewable.

   Every correction is listed with its evidence in
   `tools/asset-pipeline/ta2.mjs`, and the build fails if one of them stops
   matching a row. Corrections to rows that the vendored file adds *past the
   end of the standard* are kept in a separate table, because those are our own
   compositions rather than restorations of anything TA2 published.

   These corrections apply to both atlases: the female one joins the same file.

   As adaptations of CC BY-SA 4.0 material, these files are themselves licensed
   under Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International:
   https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/

What this means in practice
---------------------------

- These asset files may be redistributed, including commercially, provided the
  attribution above is preserved and they remain under CC BY-SA 4.0.
- The share-alike obligation attaches to the meshes and their derived label
  data. It does not extend to the Anatria3D application source code, which
  merely aggregates these assets rather than adapting them.
- Do not relicense, or claim exclusive rights over, anything in this directory.


THE FEMALE ATLAS — CC BY 4.0
============================

`*_female.glb` and `manifest_female.json` are the trunk — spine, abdominal
organs, pelvis and breast. They are not a female whole body, and no open
dataset provides one.

Attribution chain
-----------------

1. Visible Human Female
   U.S. National Library of Medicine, National Institutes of Health.
   The cryosection dataset every model below is ultimately reconstructed from.
   The Visible Human Project
   https://www.nlm.nih.gov/research/visible/visible_human.html

2. Human Reference Atlas (HRA) 3D Reference Organ Library
   HuBMAP Consortium / NIH — https://humanatlas.io/
   Digital object: ref-organ/united-female v1.5
   https://cdn.humanatlas.io/digital-objects/ref-organ/united-female/v1.5/
   Licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International
   https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

   Cite: Börner K, et al. Human Reference Atlas. The licence statement is
   machine-readable in the digital object's own metadata.json.

3. Anatria3D adaptations
   Produced by `tools/asset-pipeline/extract-hra.mjs`, entirely inside glTF —
   no Blender round trip, so the node names are byte-identical to the published
   digital object and any structure here can be checked against the HRA portal.
   The changes are: selection of 264 of the 888 structures, the node hierarchy
   flattened with transforms baked in, source materials and UV sets dropped in
   favour of shading applied by the viewer, lossy Draco compression (position
   quantisation 14 bits, normal 10), and stable organ identifiers added. No
   polygon reduction beyond what Draco quantisation implies.

   As adaptations of CC BY 4.0 material these files remain CC BY 4.0. There is
   no share-alike obligation on them, and none is imposed here.

Nomenclature, and where it differs from the source
---------------------------------------------------

The HRA labels structures with UBERON and FMA terms, which is right for its
purpose — mapping cell types — and wrong for teaching: the labels are not
unique (six pelvic meshes are labelled "compact bone tissue", naming the tissue
rather than the bone), and they word many structures differently from
Terminologia Anatomica.

So each structure was matched by hand to a TA2 term, recorded in
`tools/asset-pipeline/hra-selection.mjs`, and the build fails if any term is
absent from TA2. Eleven structures present in the source are deliberately not
shipped, because TA2 does not list them and inventing Latin for them would be
worse than omitting them. Three more that TA2 *does* name are left out by
judgement — the placenta's umbilical vessels, which alone would be a placenta
made of three tubes — and those are recorded in a separate list, so a decision
cannot borrow the standard's authority. The reasons for all fourteen are in
that same file.

Where the source and this atlas disagree, the reason is written down rather
than applied silently — including one upstream mesh whose label and ontology id
belong to a different vessel from the one its node names.

Provenance for every shipped structure — original node name, UBERON or FMA id,
source label, polygon count — is committed in
`tools/asset-pipeline/vendor/reports-female/`.

What this means in practice
---------------------------

- These files may be redistributed, including commercially, provided the
  attribution above is preserved.
- They may be modified and the result kept closed. CC BY does not require
  otherwise. This is a real difference from the male atlas.
- **Do not merge them with the male meshes or manifests.** Combining CC BY
  material into a CC BY-SA work forces share-alike onto it, which is a
  condition the HRA's authors did not choose to impose.

Nomenclature, and why nothing here is translated
------------------------------------------------

manifest.json carries two names per structure and no others: the Terminologia
Anatomica 2 Latin term, and the clinical English term. There are no localised
labels in this data and no machine translation of any kind.

That is deliberate. Rendering "Ventriculus sinister" for a layperson, a student
and a clinician calls for three different explanations, in each of the
languages the application supports — that is teaching, not a lookup table. It
is done at runtime by the AI assistant, with the reader's profile and language
in hand, and no such text is stored or redistributed here.

Redistributing this directory therefore redistributes professional
nomenclature only. If you add localised medical terminology to it, that
terminology is yours: have it reviewed by someone qualified before presenting
it as authoritative.

# Atlas asset licensing

The MIT License in `LICENSE` applies to Vanatome viewer software and repository
documentation authored for Vanatome. It does not relicense third-party or
adapted anatomy assets.

The `.glb` atlas files and associated manifest under `public/models/` are
browser-oriented adaptations of material from:

- **Z-Anatomy — The libre 3D atlas of anatomy**
- Primary creators credited by the project: Gauthier Kervyn (design, 3D,
  anatomy) and Marcin Zielinski (Python script)
- Additional contributors and upstream sources are documented by Z-Anatomy
- Source: <https://github.com/Z-Anatomy/Models>
- License: [Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International][cc]

Z-Anatomy also documents material derived from BodyParts3D, which has its own
attribution and source history. See
<https://dbarchive.biosciencedbc.jp/en/bodyparts3d/download.html> and the
Z-Anatomy repository for those notices.

Vanatome’s adaptations include web export, structure selection identifiers,
material adjustments, curve-to-mesh conversion, and geometry optimization.
When redistributing the adapted atlas material, preserve the relevant
attribution, identify modifications, include a link to the license, and follow
the applicable ShareAlike terms. This summary is provided to make provenance
visible; the linked license and upstream notices are authoritative.

Işıktan sinir sinyaline

Kornea ve mercek ışığı retinaya odaklar. Fotoreseptörler ışığı elektriksel değişimlere dönüştürür; retinal devreler bilgiyi işler ve gangliyon hücrelerinin aksonları görme sinirini oluşturur. Beyne giden şey ışığın kendisi değil, sinir sinyalleridir. Şema ölçekli değildir; ışın yolları öğretim amacıyla sadeleştirilmiştir.

Besinin yolculuğu • büyütülmüş şema

Yol ve süre sadeleştirilmiştir. 3D modelde vurgulanan organ ile bu şema aynı aşamayı gösterir.
